rounds.text: Bhagyanagar India Ltd demonstrates exceptional operational efficiency, evidenced by an ROE of 21.6% and an ROCE of 20.7%, both significantly outperforming their respective sector benchmarks [E9, E10, E13, E12]. The company’s growth trajectory is robust, highlighted by a 216% compounded profit growth over the trailing twelve months and a 49% increase in sales over the same period [E17, E21]. Management is actively scaling operations, with a planned capacity expansion to 45,000 tons and a clear revenue target of 5,000 crores by FY30 [E86, E101]. Furthermore, the company maintains strong liquidity with a current ratio of 2.00x and has successfully converted profits into cash, as shown by a 1.18x cash conversion ratio [E34, E39]. Conceded: the company carries a debt-to-equity ratio of 1.01x, indicating leverage risk [E38], and promoter holding has decreased by 9.50 percentage points since September 2023 [E42]. Despite these concerns, the business is supported by a positive institutional money flow and a sector-wide tailwind in the Metals & Mining industry [E45, E75].

evidence.quote: Going forward in the year, we hope to maintain the EBITDA margin between 5% and 5.5%.

evidence.fact: Management targets export contribution of 12% to 15% for the year.
evidence.quote: 12-15% would be a good estimate for the year.

evidence.fact: Secondary copper demand in India is projected to double over the next 5 years to 1.4 million metric tons.
evidence.quote: Out of this, if you look at the secondary copper demand, it is expected to double in the next 5 years, from 0.7 million metric tons to 1.4 million metric tons.

evidence.fact: Management sees high customer demand with clients discussing doubling capacity over the next 3 years.
evidence.quote: As of today, we see a lot of demand. All our customers are looking to increase their volumes and everybody is talking about doubling their capacity in the next 3 years.

evidence.fact: Transformer and motor winding, along with bus bars, present the highest growth potential.
evidence.quote: However, the highest growth potential we are seeing is in the transformer and motor winding, and in the bus bar area.

evidence.fact: Management has proposed 40 crores of capex across FY27 and FY28.
evidence.quote: The management has proposed to do 40 crores of capex in the next 2 years, FY27 and FY28 and we are well on our way to achieve this.

evidence.fact: Capacity expansion from 35,000 to 45,000 tons is expected to become operational between April and June of next year.
evidence.quote: The exact timelines are still not there, but as of now, our expectation is between April and June of next year; more likely June next year. From 35,000 to 45,000 tons.

evidence.fact: The company completed adding 35,000 metric tons of capacity which is currently online.
evidence.quote: We have also finished adding our capacity of 35,000 metric tons, which is online now.

evidence.fact: BIL reported an EBITDA margin of 5.43% and a PAT margin of 2.87% in Q1 FY27.
evidence.quote: We have had our highest EBITDA margin of recent times at 5.43%, our highest PAT margin of 2.87%.

evidence.fact: The company achieved an EBITDA per kg of 72 rupees during Q1 FY27.
evidence.quote: We have also had our highest share of value-added products sold this quarter, which is 63% and our highest EBITDA per kg of 72 rupees.

evidence.fact: Approximately 85% of inventory is hedged on the exchange.
evidence.quote: However, approximately 85% of the inventory which is there is hedged on the exchange.

evidence.fact: Quarterly sales volume reached 5,200 tons, with 2,200 tons recorded in June.
evidence.quote: However, for the whole quarter, our volume has come down to 5,200 tons. But the good part of this is that 2,200 tons of the 5,200 tons has come only in the month of June.

evidence.fact: CTC wire capacity is currently around 80 metric tons per month and is expanding to 150 metric tons per month.
evidence.quote: On CTC wires, our capacity is roughly about 80 metric tons a month and we will be going up to 150 metric tons a month.

evidence.fact: The company recorded a sales volume of 5,278 MT in Q1FY27.
evidence.quote: Sales Volume (MT) 5278

evidence.fact: BIL finalized the first round of fundraise amounting to 52 crores.
evidence.quote: So, we have just finalized the first round of raising, at 52 crores, which is finalized, and the money should be in the bank in the month of August.

evidence.fact: Long-term projections indicate company debt levels between 300 and 350 crores in 2030.
evidence.quote: So, our projection is showing that between 300 and 350 crores will be our debt in 2030.

evidence.fact: Under the demerger, Bhagyanagar India will retain real estate land parcels and a windmill project, transferring copper infrastructure to Tieramet Limited.
evidence.quote: So, what will be left in Bhagyanagar India will be the three land parcels, which are in the heart of the city and our windmill project, while Tieramet will have all our copper infrastructure and businesses.

evidence.fact: Trade route disruptions and material shortages impacted operations during the first two months of the quarter.
evidence.quote: In the first two months, because of the disruption of all the trade routes and the shortage of material all over the country, while the turnover came down, we could take advantage of the situation by increasing our margins.

evidence.fact: BIL was assessed a GST case following retrospective cancellation of a supplier's registration.
evidence.quote: Because of the retrospective cancellation of the registration of the supplier, the case has been put on us.

evidence.fact: Management commitment (next 2 years): Management proposed to execute a capex of 40 crores over FY27 and FY28.
evidence.quote: The management has proposed to do 40 crores of capex in the next 2 years, FY27 and FY28 and we are well on our way to achieve this.

evidence.fact: Management commitment (next year): Management expects capacity to increase from 35,000 to 45,000 tons between April and June of next year.
evidence.quote: The exact timelines are still not there, but as of now, our expectation is between April and June of next year; more likely June next year. From 35,000 to 45,000 tons.

evidence.fact: Management commitment (FY30): Management commits to achieving 5,000 crores in revenue by FY30.
evidence.quote: But we are very confident of 5,000 crores by FY30, whatever the copper price.

evidence.fact: Management commitment (next year): Management plans to execute a complete digital transformation of all company processes over the next year.
evidence.quote: Over the next year, we are going to do a complete digital transformation of our company, where every process, every department and all reporting will be completely digitalized automatically, and no manual entry would be required.
